params.name: href
params.description: Link destination. A real URL — this component is navigation, not tabs.

params.name: current
params.description: Marks the current page with `aria-current="page"`. The visual treatment follows from that attribute, so it cannot be applied without also being announced.

name: ariaLabel
description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark. Defaults to `Sub navigation`. Set it when a page has more than one, so they are distinguishable.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the navigation.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the navigation.
